title: docs(types): stop the ViewNavigationConfig docblock teaching the retired navigation.view
body:
Fixes #9938
Clause-②: no

## What

The published `ViewNavigationConfig` docblock in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` taught authors `navigation: { view: 'summary_view' }` as legal authored metadata. `view.list.navigation.view` was removed in `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 under ADR-0049: it becomes a tombstone that types `never` and refuses at parse. The sentence's real point is that `mode` is optional on the authoring side; `view` was only the carrier.

The example now reads `navigation: { openNewTab: true }`, which lets the mode default to `'page'`, the mode `openNewTab` applies to. Comment-only. No type, export or runtime behaviour moves. One `@object-ui/types` patch changeset, because the docblock ships in the package's `.d.ts`.

## Replacement key, measured on both sides of the removal

A `NavigationConfigSchema.safeParse` probe, run against both specs:

- installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 (`@objectstack/spec/ui`): `{ openNewTab: true }` gives OK `{"mode":"page","preventNavigation":false,"openNewTab":true,"size":"auto"}`; `{ view: 'summary_view' }` gives OK (the key still exists there).
- objectstack `packages/spec` source at `2c1011b`, run via tsx: `{ openNewTab: true }` gives the same OK output; `{ view: 'summary_view' }` gives REJECT `invalid_type` at `["view"]`, message starting "`view.list.navigation.view` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17.5.0".

## Population the card lists, re-measured on `origin/main` `fa5fbd9dc`

| Site | Verdict | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `objectql.ts`, `ViewNavigationConfig` docblock | changed here | a published comment that an author reads |
| `gantt-declared-keys.test.ts`, both legs | correct-as-is | already rewritten on main to `{ mode: 'page', openNewTab: false }`, with a tombstone note (the objectui#9667 change) |
| `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`, accept-leg value | correct-as-is | already carries `size` in place of `view`, with a tombstone note |
| `ListView.ganttNavigationForward-7334.test.tsx`, authored value and `toEqual` | correct-as-is | already `{ mode: 'split', size: 'lg' }` |
| `view-navigation-config-spec-parity.test.ts` comments naming `{ view: 'summary_view' }` | correct-as-is | they record that `view` is now a tombstone |
| `gridNavigationMembers-8071`, `useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault`, `readme-navigation-example` tests authoring `view: 'summary_view'` | correct-as-is | deliberate retirement pins: they assert that the value is NOT read |

A multiline scan for any `navigation` object literal (JS or JSON spelling) that carries a `view` member, excluding CHANGELOGs, hits only the docblock line (zero after this change). The control is the same pattern with `mode` in place of `view`: it matches 51 files. No shipped example metadata authors `navigation.view`, so no example behaviour changes on 17.4.0.
